hazards.explanation: Dose is on the expected track for this point in the mission.

hazards.headline: Mood 2.5/5 · sleep 6.0 h
hazards.explanation: Mood has been lower than usual, and reported stress has risen. Protected rest time and a private call home can help.

hazards.headline: 5m 31s delay · workload 59/100
hazards.explanation: Stress is up while decisions rest with the crew, and workload is heavy. Flag tasks that can wait and keep medical supplies under review.

hazards.headline: Bone −4.2% since launch
hazards.explanation: Leg strength is declining, and bone is thinning faster than the target. Keep up daily exercise and report any change in vision or headaches.

hazards.headline: CO₂ 3.2 mmHg (48 h)
hazards.explanation: The immune system looks suppressed, and sleep has been more broken. Report headaches; the life-support team is checking air and ventilation.

hazards.headline: 319 mSv · 53% of career limit
hazards.explanation: Dose is higher than the rest of the crew. Keep storm-shelter procedures fresh and limit time in lightly shielded modules.

hazards.explanation: Mood, sleep and stress are in the usual range.

hazards.headline: 5m 31s delay · workload 54/100
hazards.explanation: Workload and support from Earth are manageable.

hazards.headline: Bone −2.0% since launch
hazards.explanation: Headaches and vision changes suggest fluid shifting toward the head, and near vision has changed. Keep up daily exercise and report any change in vision or headaches.

hazards.headline: CO₂ 3.5 mmHg (48 h)
hazards.explanation: Air, noise and immune markers are in a healthy range.

insights.title: Isolation stress rising
insights.summary: 5 independent signals for Hannan point the same way: lower mood, higher reported stress, suppressed HRV and fewer check-ins. The trend started around D112 and has not levelled off.

insights.title: Sleep debt building ahead of EVA-3
insights.summary: Ahmad has averaged 5.4 h of sleep over the last 5 nights, 1.5 h below personal baseline. The decline started with the planned sleep shift. EVA-3 is in 4 days.

insights.title: Exercise sessions missed
insights.summary: Hannan completed 4 of 14 scheduled exercise sessions in the last 14 days. Weekly bone and lean-mass measurements are now declining faster than the countermeasure target.

insights.title: Headaches with vision change. SANS screen advised
insights.summary: Sabaina reported headaches on 4 of the last 7 check-ins and a change in near vision on D140. Resting systolic pressure has crept up over the same period.

insights.title: Cabin CO₂ above 3 mmHg for 46 h
insights.summary: Crew CO₂ exposure has averaged 3.4 mmHg over 48 h (CO₂ scrubber bed B degraded, D140). 3 headache reports across the crew in 3 days.

insights.title: Highest cumulative radiation dose on crew
insights.summary: Sabaina is at 319 mSv (53% of career limit), 43 mSv above the crew median. Most of the gap comes from late storm-shelter entry during the D97 solar particle event.

insights.title: Bone loss within countermeasure target
insights.summary: Hashir's femoral neck density is −1.2% since launch (−0.26%/month), inside the −0.5%/month target. Exercise compliance is consistent.

insights.title: Workload high during EVA-3 prep
insights.summary: Ahmad rated workload 71/100 on the latest weekly questionnaire, above personal baseline (56).

interp.summary: Over the last 7 days heart rate averaged 66 bpm, within Ahmad's normal range (51–72 bpm). The trend is stable.
interp.why: A resting heart rate that stays above normal can reflect stress, poor sleep, illness or deconditioning.

interp.summary: Over the last 7 days sleep duration averaged 5.7 h, −18% versus Ahmad's normal (6.9 h), below the usual range. The trend is falling.
interp.why: Accumulated sleep loss degrades reaction time, procedural memory and error detection. During EVA suit operations these errors carry the highest consequence on the mission.

interp.summary: Over the last 7 days co₂ exposure, partial pressure averaged 2.7 mmHg, within Ahmad's normal range (2.2–2.8 mmHg). The trend is rising.
interp.why: Chronic CO₂ above 3 mmHg is linked to headache, reduced cognitive performance and poorer sleep. All four crew are exposed.

interp.summary: Over the last 7 days mood averaged 3.6/5, within Ahmad's normal range (3.1–4.6/5). The trend is falling.
interp.why: Mood is the earliest self-reported sign of isolation stress.
